targets.old_statement: Inside a roundabout stay right of the center island, remember circulating vehicles have the right-of-way, and do not stop except to avoid a crash, change lanes or pass any vehicle.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Inside a roundabout stay right of the center island, remember circulating vehicles have the right-of-way, and do not stop except to avoid a crash, change lanes or pass any vehicle.
targets.statement: While driving through a roundabout, keep right of the center island, yield the right-of-way to circulating vehicles, never change lanes or try to pass any vehicle, and do not stop unless stopping is the only way to avoid a crash.
